title: A warm home, a nervous prospective Solsworn
boundary: Narrated childhood/pre-departure episode. Family warmth and expectations coexist; no withdrawal of love is shown.

title: A gift that does not supply universal understanding
boundary: Narrated experience of runes and the Reactor Drive blessing. The character does not know the source civilization; annotated metaphors do not identify it.

title: The Exoswarm intervention: success with a failed final rune
boundary: Redundant preparation and Soliskin assistance coexist with fear after success. Do not rewrite this as an unqualified defeat or a triumph of omnipotence.

title: The student who must learn unfamiliar subjects and systems
boundary: Narrated school adjustment, not evidence of low intelligence or incompetence in every technical domain.

title: Returning home and beginning to tell the truth
boundary: Later narrated homecoming. Opening disclosure is not a claim that concealment can never recur.

title: Forte examinations and unknown birthday
boundary: In-world institutional records. Negative Synchronist qualification, potential Overclocking risk, and no Overclocking history must remain separate predicates; no real-world diagnosis.

title: Reputation before direct acquaintance
boundary: Other speakers praise a future candidate. Candidate status is not current tenure among the Heliodic Six.

title: Classroom visibility and counseling
boundary: Sigrika cannot be given Rover’s private access to Aemeath. The anonymous introduction in 10663/3/6 is not Sigrika; counseling is actually present before the central crisis.

title: Roya cultural competence and peer reciprocity
boundary: Lynae’s testimony supports tutoring and concern. It does not make Sigrika equally proficient at every course.

title: The scholarship of friendship: approaching Denia
boundary: Denia’s archive supplies observer/relationship evidence, including her own concealed intentions. These are not facts Sigrika necessarily knows.

title: Festival pleasure and the private wish
boundary: Dialogue options and repeated activities are alternatives. A personal wish can remain private without its exact contents being invented.

title: Rune explanation, childhood games, and questions without known answers
boundary: Sigrika’s account supplies epistemic limits and three-dimensional description. Rumors about Dark Side entities remain rumors until identified.

title: Winning can convert play into a duty to keep winning
boundary: Recalled/projected material is used with the archive and present response; it is not independent access to the literal private thoughts of every friend.

title: Speed, the mother’s reflection, and escalating pressure
boundary: Dream/reflection speech is not real family testimony. Generic observer items 12923/2/15–17 remain unresolved.

title: Protection experienced as exclusion
boundary: Lucilla’s safety concern and Dr. Luuk’s confidence discussion are competing contextual descriptions, not proof of a cruel school or a clinical diagnosis.

title: Candy, pranks, and mixed feelings
boundary: Candy interactions have branches. Preserve the playful boundary lapse rather than casting all her care as faultless consent practice.

title: Rescue request and an accelerated recognition of adulthood
boundary: She offers relevant expertise and insists people are at risk. The culturally framed ceremony does not establish a numerical age or an unlimited permission to self-endanger.

title: The two earlier diaries
boundary: Private written self-address. A schedule, a fear, and an asserted obligation are not three independent observed actions.

title: Chisa: complementary rescue roles
boundary: Different competencies solve different parts of a rescue. No universal power ranking follows.

title: Alia: recognizing a problem does not produce an answer
boundary: Sigrika’s standard exhortation is insufficient. Alia’s experience cannot be reduced to a lesson about Sigrika alone.

title: The nightmare’s demand for a single correct response
boundary: Nightmare and counterpart speech exploit familiar people and roles; they are not impartial witnesses to those people’s actual attitudes.

title: After the nightmare: self-blame and assistance without substitution
boundary: Her account of originating the voice is an affected self-report, not a complete causal account of the Fractsidus operation. The four localizations phrase self-reliance differently.

title: Weighing the last entry without guaranteed correctness
boundary: She considers risks on both sides, seeks views, chooses, and asks to be awakened if lost. No claim that doubt disappears.

title: Exact impersonation boundary
boundary: Items 0,1,3 reuse 150088 but belong to the counterpart. FORM_IDENTITY.json explicitly adjudicates them. Do not globally reassign other 150088 occurrences.

title: Admitting the wish to escape without surrendering judgment
boundary: Direct speech at items 29–37 is distinguished from the preceding counterpart/Rover annotated sequence. Recognition of a thought does not make the counterpart a faithful total self.

title: Refusing another speaker’s definition of her effort
boundary: Chinese 131_5 says this time; English expands to from now on. The scene licenses a present decision, not permanent selfishness or invulnerability.

title: After the immediate Dark Side resolution
boundary: Laughter and continuing duties coexist. The crisis’s local resolution does not prove every Fractsidus threat or Dark Side danger ended.

title: The folded black cat and an apology
boundary: A handmade, slightly crooked thank-you/apology object. Tender effort is not proof of expert craft or exclusive romance.

title: Overtraining, concentrated attention, and learning rest
boundary: The source explicitly places these cooperation events within progression gates, not as automatic post-recovery relapse.

title: Birdwatching and sharing a place of refuge
boundary: Bird interest is real and longstanding, not invented solely to symbolize the crisis. The photograph’s creation is narrated, not visually inspected here.

title: Temporary retreat and later chosen joy
boundary: The distressed rooftop and later happy rooftop belong to different gated states. Comfort is not identical to abolishing the problem.

title: Rhythm play and the mind after a submitted assignment
boundary: Relaxation by changing attention, not an acoustic observation or a medical treatment claim.

title: A phone call no longer limited to reassurance
boundary: Chinese reports attempts to decline unmanageable work; Korean has a more prospective formulation. Do not present identical tense in all witnesses.

title: Changing the diary rather than only the declaration
boundary: Written nonurgent plans are replaced with rest. Permission to inspect this diary is contextual, not a global permission to read private materials.

title: Food, domestic warmth, and one firm aversion
boundary: A gameplay caption’s not-picky label cannot cancel the explicit Grilled Fern Spore aversion. Mother’s Fruit Crackle and her own version are distinct.

title: Small domestic artifacts and improvising sweets
boundary: Object descriptions are textual representation/paratext, not newly viewed clothes or props. The bag names care and constraint together; the improvised candy succeeds once.

title: Animals, cameras, luck, and a warning against overinterpretation
boundary: The source itself resists inflating a wish to share happiness into a total philosophy of nature. A luck legend is not experimentally established.

title: Elective films, music, and celebration
boundary: A particular missed fan event is not permanent neglect of all leisure. Class popularity is a reported experience, not a scheduling census.

title: Family gifts, travel, and bringing stories home
boundary: Desired travel and a birthday gift are not completed journeys or an exact calendar birthday for Sigrika.

title: Culturally framed closeness and finite friendship
boundary: A hug’s warmth and a wish for lasting friendship do not establish exclusive romantic status. Soliskin’s stated choice is not general approval of every self-sacrifice.

title: Denia and Lynae through Sigrika’s voice
boundary: Sigrika observes a gap between Denia’s escape rhetoric and staying behavior; she admits she cannot fully read Denia’s heart.

title: Different other-person perspectives on her burden
boundary: Teacher and peer opinions are attributed perspectives. Denia’s innocent-victim framing does not become the dossier’s total explanatory model.

title: Research, evacuation, and practical distributed competence
boundary: Sigrika’s rune insight, Mornye’s reconstruction, Rover’s interpretation, and others’ logistics remain separate contributions.

title: Later academic weakness and continued tutoring
boundary: Continuing difficulty in science is compatible with growth in agency. Rumors about an entire academic division require their in-scene correction.

title: Denia’s restricted outing and the photograph
boundary: The restriction protocol and Denia/Rover conversations are reader-side knowledge; Sigrika’s information must be separately established.

title: The white bird and asymmetric knowledge
boundary: Sigrika’s new-species belief is not objective taxonomy. The private Hiyuki-related explanation is not automatically information she receives.

title: Cake, preference, and a request for next year
boundary: Orange preference and practical cake advice coexist with perception of concealment. Agreement about next year is not proof that next year occurs.

title: Concern that seeks information without owning another’s secrets
boundary: Nivora’s nonreturn is directly confirmed; Denia’s letter is reported. The complete undisplayed letter cannot be fabricated.

title: Later hope and the limits of a farewell summary
boundary: The summary frames acceptance and hope, while direct scenes preserve specific knowledge and grief. No verified reunion is supplied.

title: Rebecca: reciprocal learning beyond the rune domain
boundary: Crossover-labeled material stays in its source family. Gaming cooperation and hearing David’s story are not new expertise in that world’s whole history.

title: Farewell and an outward-facing future
boundary: Travel aspirations and invitations survive separation. No invented later career, residence, or romance.

title: Expository counterpart identity and literal exclusions
boundary: FORM_IDENTITY.json plus occurrence_identity_crosswalk.jsonl govern counterpart impersonation at 12955/4/0,1,3; rejected generic 10663/3/6 and unresolved 12923/2/15–17 are enumerated in the census.

title: Verified waveform evidence and semantic/render identity
boundary: Original direct/counterpart semantic-render crosswalks plus actual FLAC/PCM-verified recordings and reproducible V0.2 signal analysis. Measurement is not perceptual or emotion judgment.

title: Source lock, release manifest, and coverage audit
boundary: SOURCE_LOCK.json says source_generation_frozen=false; COLLECTION_AUDIT.json and SIGRIKA_RELEASE_MANIFEST.json say true. Sixteen downloaded evidence payloads match release SHA-256 entries. This does not certify remote FLAC bytes.

title: Ludic identity and state-tagged archive language
boundary: Archive/growth/combat triggers are not a chronology. Defeat lines do not establish canonical death or a later reversal of recovery.

title: Authority, care, and ordinary creativity at the clinic
boundary: Candy suggestions and recognition of care show participation, not just passive treatment. No direct listening judgment.

title: The larger manipulation cannot be assigned to her alone
boundary: Antagonist/authority perspectives qualify Sigrika’s causal self-blame. She does not necessarily witness all backstage statements.

title: The selected quest summary without its full scene witness
boundary: A Perfect Flight Day/aurora-flight material is retained as summary/title evidence. No directly matching aurora-flight dialogue was located in the 252 selected contexts; do not invent its choreography or inner arc.

title: The branching choice between inner voice and expectations
boundary: Raw TidTalkOption and SequenceTransitions preserve alternatives. Choosing one Rover option is not a canonical Sigrika belief or an observed choice of every player.

title: Sensory attention and the wish to share a world
boundary: New rune interest and ordinary scenery belong to the continuing life; evidence for curiosity does not settle the unknown runes’ provenance.
